notes: Each side's initiative rating is added to one die at the start of every game turn (SPI 7.1x, rules/20-sequence-of-play.md). The Commonwealth rating rises with the calendar; the Axis rating depends on whether Rommel, or failing him any German land combat unit, is on the game maps — units in the Tripoli/Tunisia holding boxes on map A do not count (chart note)
